The '''duel on Coruscant''' took place in [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] near the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple District]] as a Jedi mission to hunt down the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and Jedi-killer [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Peerce]] was chosen to lead the assignment with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[J'Mikel]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Xiaan Amersu]] in tow; the team discovered that Sing had slain several [[Republic Peace Officer]]s before splitting up to cover more ground. Peerce was the first killed with J'Mikel following not long after. But Sing spared Amersu with a promise that the two would face each other again sometime in the future.<ref name="Duel" />

This confrontation alarmed the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] which decided to dedicate further resources to bring Sing to justice. The Council sent a small task force [[Hunt for Aurra Sing|to locate her]] not long after.<ref name="Duel" />

==The ambush==
{{Quote|I'm going to enjoy killing you, Jedi|Aurra Sing to J'Mikel after the latter slashes at her face|<ref name="Duel" />}}
[[File:PeerceDeath.jpg|left|thumb|232x232px|J'Mikel discorvers Peerce]]
The infamous [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] was known for murdering Jedi at various stages which at one point [[Duel on Kwannot|included]] [[Mana Veridi]] on [[Kwannot]]. Her actions concerned the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] who decided that Sing needed to be captured. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Peerce]] was assigned to hunt Sing down on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant itself]]; [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[J'Mikel]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Xiaan Amersu]] were also assigned to the mission with Peerce.<ref name="Duel" />

The three Jedi searched for the assassin in [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|the underworld]] close to the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple District]] and after some time discovered a slain group of [[Republic Peace Officer]]s. Discovering this scene prompted the Jedi Master to suggest splitting up in order to cover more ground. But the Jedi were unaware that Sing was still in the area and was stalking them; she sliced into Peerce (after he found a [[Unidentified Republic Peace Officer|Duro officer]] in a different location) and then used cabling to hoist him up for the other Jedi to see before she engaged and [[Shiak|impaled]] J'Mikel before stealing his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Duel" />

But Sing spared Amersu and promised her that the two would meet and engage each other again at some stage in the future when Amersu's abilities were further developed.<ref name="Duel" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Go! Mourn your dear master! Find another and learn your lessons well. Someday you will become a Jedi Knight. Then Aurra will kill you, too|Aurra Sing's parting words to Xiaan Amersu|<ref name="Duel" />}}
Xiaan Amersu was placed in the care in Jedi physicians to recover from what she saw while the High Council decided to assemble a team of Jedi to hunt Sing down and [[Hunt for Aurra Sing|bring her to justice]].<ref name="Duel" />
